summary: The details for this species have not been published yet.

population.notes: Tier A override: SANParks 25–30 breeding pairs (+ few non-breeders). Kemp 2001 baseline was 16–64 mature individuals (2^5, visiting breeder).

sources.title: Kemp A.C., Herholdt J.J., Whyte I. & Harrison J. (2001). Birds of the two largest national parks in South Africa: a method to generate estimates of population size for all species and assess their conservation ecology. S. Afr. J. Sci. 97: 393–403.

kempBaseline.notes: Kemp et al. 2001 order-of-magnitude threshold 2^5=32 mature individuals (visiting breeder); paper interval half–double → 16–64.
